text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Palestine Liberation Organisation official says PLO ready for reconciliation with Kuwait which has repeatedly turned down similar overtures. The PLO was seen as an Iraq sympathiser during its 1990-91 occupation of Kuwait and ties between the once close allies have been strained since.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange index rises 29.2 points on Monday to 2,114 points.
- British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind says no differnces with the United States over Iraq.
- Kuwaiti MP proposes harsh jail sentences and heavy fines for abusing or assaulting civil servants while on duty.

- Religious, sectarian, political and above all, tribal factors will decide who wins the two prize seats of Kuwait's largest constituency of Ahmadi. The Constitutional Court in January ordered fresh elections for the parliamentary seats after uncovering irregularities in an October poll. The new poll will be held on Wednesday.
